parts.text: What are our current YTD spend and earned volume rebate tiers for each vendor in 2026?

Based on internal rebate agreement data for FY 2026: Apex Apparel (VND-001) has YTD spend of $1,250,000 reaching Tier 2 (5.0% rebate); Summit Outdoor (VND-002) has YTD spend of $650,000 reaching Tier 1 (2.5% rebate); Cascade Gear (VND-003) has YTD spend of $450,000 reaching Tier 1 (2.0% rebate); Alpine Tech (VND-004) has YTD spend of $350,000 at Base tier; and Pacific Threads (VND-005) has YTD spend of $520,000 reaching Tier 2 (3.0% rebate).
What is the status of our co-op marketing fund claims and pending approvals for 2026-Q3?

For 2026-Q3 co-op marketing funds across campaigns: Apex Apparel (VND-001/CMP-001) has $50,000 committed, $45,000 claimed, $40,000 approved, and $5,000 pending; Summit Outdoor (VND-002/CMP-002) has $40,000 committed, $38,000 claimed, $35,000 approved, and $3,000 pending; Cascade Gear (VND-003/CMP-003) has $30,000 committed, $25,000 claimed, $20,000 approved, and $5,000 pending; and Alpine Tech (VND-004/CMP-004) has $25,000 committed, $20,000 claimed, $18,000 approved, and $2,000 pending, based on internal co-op marketing data.
What is our rebate realization percentage and outstanding dispute amount across vendors for 2026-Q3?

Based on internal settlement data for 2026-Q3: Pacific Threads achieved 95% rebate realization ($14,820 collected of $15,600 earned, $780 disputed); Apex Apparel achieved 90% realization ($56,250 collected of $62,500 earned, $6,250 disputed); Summit Outdoor achieved 85% realization ($24,862.50 collected of $29,250 earned, $4,387.50 disputed); and Cascade Gear achieved 80% realization ($7,200 collected of $9,000 earned, $1,800 disputed).
What are typical industry benchmarks for vendor volume rebates and co-op marketing fund commitments in retail merchandising?

Typical retail industry benchmarks for annual volume rebates range between 2% and 6% depending on product category and order volume tiers, while co-op marketing fund commitments generally average 1% to 3% of gross purchase volume, based on external market data.
